blocked_arm_effects.model_note: the printed number is a coefficient of a mixed linear model with Treatment, gender and the interaction; engine request: an OLS / mixed-model slope op (field on withField with fixed covariates and a per-treatment slope); `correlation` is the nearest computable quantity (sign and strength of the same relation) and is NOT the reported coefficient, so no compareAs is set

estimates.variant: Table 2: Logarithm of the stakes, mixed linear model (SPSS 18), dependent variable the relative share, explanatory variables log of the amount, Treatment, gender and Treatment x log amount; within-subject dependence in Treatment Five filtered 'in the model' (p. 3)

reported.n_note: n = 524 participants (p. 3); the model rows are 928 game rows (423 Treatment One + 5 x 101 Treatment Five), and the printed df are fractional Satterthwaite-type values, so n is not t df + 2

cite.label: reported
cite.note: Table 2, row 'Logarithm of the stakes' (minus sign typeset as U+2212, checked on the page image); text p. 3 (bottom of the right column): significant negative relationship (DG p = 0.034, UG p < 0.001, MAO p = 0.001). Effect = change of the relative share per unit of the log amount (base derived: log10, units.games.cites.log_amount)

blocked_arm_effects.label: Dictator Game offer: relative share, female minus male

Gender is not manipulated, so the model term is close to, not equal to, the difference of the raw group means; the raw mean_difference over game rows also counts each Treatment Five person five times, whereas the paper's model filtered within-subject dependence (p. 3)
